gloss: secret teachings; mysteries; essence of an art

definitions.gloss: secret teachings; mysteries; hidden essence of an art
definitions.explanation: The deepest, most advanced principles of an art, discipline, or skill. Originally referred to the inner teachings of martial arts or traditional arts, now also used more broadly for mastering the core of any field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{奥義|おうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned the secret teachings from my master.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥義|おうぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かすことだ。
examples.english: The essence of cooking is bringing out the best in the ingredients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何十年|なんじゅうねん}→何十年：30624_nanjuunen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}して→修行する：25391_shugyousuru⟧、ようやく⟦{剣術|けんじゅつ}→剣術：20194_kenjutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥義|おうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}めた→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧。
examples.english: After decades of training, he finally mastered the deepest secrets of swordsmanship.

notes:
A word rooted in traditional martial arts and performing arts. It suggests knowledge that is not easily acquired and can only be attained through long dedication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奥義|おうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ (to master the deepest secrets)
- {奥義|おうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧ (to pass on secret teachings)
- {奥義|おうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{授|さず}かる→授かる：12797_sazukaru⟧ (to receive secret teachings)

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read おくぎ, but おうぎ is the more common and standard reading.
